source.scope: Captive adult common marmosets at the UZH Primate Station, Switzerland: three adult males and three adult females (six subjects), tested in eight mixed-sex dyads after excluding one sibling combination. The assigned-pair study used repeated short visual exposures and pair-housing tests from February through August 2022; partners were not chosen by the animals.

claims.text: Before assigned pair formation, repeated short visual exposures of initially unfamiliar captive common marmosets were associated with a model-estimated 32.3% decrease in direct interindividual distance per exposure. After pair formation, mating status had no clear association with direct distance (P = 0.37). The result concerns eight mixed-sex dyads of six adults at one station and this short assay; it does not show that proximity is a general marker of pair-bond maintenance or describe wild grouping.
claims.textZh: 在研究者安排配对前，圈养普通狨猴中原本陌生的个体经过多次短时视觉接触后，模型估计其直接个体间距离每增加一次接触减少 32.3%。配对形成后，配偶身份与直接距离之间未显示明确关联（P = 0.37）。结果来自单一研究站的 6 只成年个体、8 个混合性别配对及这一短时测验；它不能证明接近距离是维持配对关系的通用指标，也不描述野外群体结构。
claims.locator: Methods, Experimental Design; Results, Spatial Proximity (model estimate before pairing and mating-status comparison after pairing); Discussion, interpretation of proximity as a context-dependent measure.
claims.placeTimeScope: UZH Primate Station, Switzerland; data collected February–August 2022. Six captive adults (three males and three females) formed eight analyzed mixed-sex dyads; each dyad had six short visual-exposure sessions in the before- and after-pairing periods.
claims.lifeStatus: Captive adults in researcher-assigned pairs; no free-ranging, domesticated, or fossil observations are included.

claims.text: In 91 analyzed recordings, the study recorded 436 sociosexual behaviors. A pooled model estimated about 1.2 more behavior scan-counts across the nine scans in a session before pair formation than after it (P = 0.023); after pairing, observed counts were lowest in pair-mate dyads and higher in less familiar extra-pair dyads. These are exploratory captive observations from assigned pairs, not estimates of wild mating behavior, sexual exclusivity, or population-wide social organization.
claims.textZh: 在 91 段纳入分析的录像中，研究共记录 436 次性社交行为。合并模型估计，配对形成前每次会话的 9 个扫描点中，行为扫描计数比配对形成后约多 1.2 次（P = 0.023）；配对形成后，观察到的行为计数在配偶配对中最低，在较不熟悉的非配偶配对中较高。这些是研究者分配配偶后的圈养探索性观察，不是野外交配行为、性排他性或种群级社会组织的估计。
claims.locator: Methods, Sociosexual Behavior; Results, Sociosexual Behavior (91 recordings, 436 behaviors, pooled model and pair-mate/extra-pair comparison); Discussion, limits on interpreting sexual motivation and pair bonding.
claims.placeTimeScope: UZH Primate Station, Switzerland; observations collected February–August 2022. Pooled scan-count analysis used 91 recordings from captive common marmosets in the assigned-pair experiment; each five-minute session had nine 30-second scans.
claims.lifeStatus: Captive adults in researcher-assigned pairs; no free-ranging, domesticated, or fossil observations are included.

ecology: The added pair-formation evidence is one exploratory captive assay from six adults at a single station; partner assignment did not allow mate choice, and natural dispersal, mate choice, wild social relationships, and population variation remain unassessed.
